 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.323/2023 dated 26.05.2023 registered at Police Station Patan., District Jabalpur (M.P) for the offences punishable under Sections 304(B)
and 498A and 34 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent lady and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is in custody since 27.06.2023 and trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Jabalpur and he is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Prosecution story is that the applicant is the mother in law of the deceased who was being harassed by the applicant and co-accused persons.
The FIR itself suggests that there was a demand of Rs.1,00,000/- made by the applicant from the deceased in dowry.

The arguments of the learned counsel for the applicant are that the demand of dowry was allegedly being Laxmi Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115426870/
1 made by the husband of the deceased as stated by the witnesses in their statement and there is no allegation about the demand of dowry against present applicant in those statements but the statements of mother of deceased recorded during Marg inquiry on 24.05.2023 reflects that the deceased was being harassed both by her husband as well as mother in law who used to question the dowry brought by her and ask her to bring money from her maternal house.

sentences.text: Similarly, the statements of Yuvraj Choudhary recorded on 24.05.2023 suggests that even on 08.05.2023, the deceased had disclosed the fact of demand of dowry to him.
Looking to the allegation against the applicant the application is rejected.
Accordingly, the M.Cr.C is dismissed.
